title: DANISH SUPERSTAR D1MA SIGNS WITH WARNER MUSIC

body_markdown:
**COPENHAGEN, 3RD SEPTEMBER 2026 –** D1MA, one of Denmark’s most prominent and influential artists, has officially signed with Warner Music Denmark. The signing marks a major new chapter in his career as he prepares to expand his signature sound to global audiences.


Renowned for blending innovative melodic drill with traditional pop and electronic beats, D1MA rapidly transformed from an enigmatic newcomer into a chart-topping sensation. The artist burst onto the scene in 2022 with his single “Drøm mig væk” which peaked at Number Four in the local charts and has since gone 4x Platinum.


In 2023, he released his debut album *EV1GT&ALT1D* , which debuted at Number One on the Danish charts and earned Double-Platinum status. Later that year he followed it with the standalone single “I KNOW,” which topped the national charts and went 4x Platinum, before teaming up with Tobias Rahim for the mega-hit “Bellevue” – a track that dominated the Number One spot for nine consecutive weeks.


D1MA has continued his exceptionally prolific run this year – delivering a string of hits, including three Top 10s with ‘Spøgelse’ (Number 10), ‘Blessed’ (Number Seven) and ‘PPC’ (Number Four).


Having shattered streaming records (more than 350 million streams – averaging nearly 60 streams per Danish citizen), earned top industry awards (Lyricist of the Year at the Carl Prisen 2026 award), and headlined major national festivals (Roskilde Festival), D1MA will now leverage Warner Music’s global network to take his music beyond Denmark’s borders while continuing to build on his massive domestic foundation.


Karen Vincent, Managing Director, Warner Music Denmark, said: “D1MA is a generational talent who has completely redefined the sound of Danish pop and drill. His drive, distinct artistic vision, and ability to connect with listeners are unmatched. We’re delighted to welcome him to the Warner Music family and look forward to supporting his journey both at home and around the world.”


Mark Fry, President, Warner Music Nordics, added: “D1MA’s impact on the music scene in Denmark is undeniable, and his creative output has clear cross-border appeal. We are fully committed to backing his artistic vision and bringing his music to exciting new markets across the globe.”
